title: •Commando Training
caption: •Commando Training (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Ben Kenobi is deploy +1. Your C-3PO, Lando, and Rebels (except {set:ds2} Jedi) ignore location deployment restrictions (and “power -1”) in their game text and apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location. Once per game, may ▼ a {ovs:3} Effect. {alter}
lore: Han’s Rebel strike team on the forest moon of Endor was highly trained in the use of blasters and explosives.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber. Inline icons: blue sphere with red stripes before 'Jedi' → {set:ds2} (matches set-ds2-grainy; stub 'Death Star II-set Jedi'); beige striped sphere before 'Effect' → {ovs:3} = the Original Virtual Set 3 sphere (matches ovs-set-3; stub 'Virtual Set 3 Effect') — a different VS's sphere, written like vs8's {ovs:8}; trailing {alter}. Curly double quotes “power -1”. Margin credits: left 'Original concept by Proofing Team', right 'PC Volunteer Award 2005'. Lore corrected: curly apostrophe Han’s (wiki straight). Only a 350 px scan; copyright Endor 1999 by set. Modern: V27-L-commandotraining.gif (745 px, VS27 remake); VB3 (350) and VB6 combo card also exist.
